introHtml: Recycled PET picnic items let you serve sustainably without sacrificing durability. Made from post-consumer plastic bottles, these plates, cups, and utensils are sturdy enough for company picnics, trade show giveaways, or employee appreciation events. Choose full-color imprinting on plates or cups to keep your logo visible from start to finish, while reinforcing your commitment to the environment.
